[F]fall asleep

Dream of days when I
wasn't all alone

[Chorus]
[Gmadd9]All that I know is gone
[Bbmaj7]All that I know is gone
Fall
[Cm6]deeper and deeper, The
sirens are singing Your
[Bbmaj7]songs

[Gmadd9]I'll miss my breath, There's no more
left I'll miss the sound of The wind
at my back The depths have a num-
ber, They call you by name
[F]Fall asleep,
Davy Jones calls you So
fall asleep,
Fall asleep and dream

[Chorus]
